name: @workspace/game-forge-desktop
description: Native Windows desktop wrapper for Grudge Forge with on-disk 3D tools.

scripts.build:renderer: cross-env PORT=24426 BASE_PATH=./ pnpm --filter @workspace/game-forge run build
scripts.build: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:main
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,tsc,electron -c blue,yellow,magenta "pnpm run dev:renderer" "pnpm run dev:main:watch" "pnpm run dev:main:run"
scripts.dev:renderer: cross-env PORT=24426 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/game-forge run dev
scripts.dev:main:run: wait-on http://localhost:24426 dist/main/main.js && cross-env GAMEFORGE_DEV_URL=http://localhost:24426/ electron .
scripts.release: pnpm run build && electron-builder --win --publish always --config electron-builder.yml
